name: Twingate
author: gradiscp
description: Twingate client at a glance: connection state, connect and disconnect (through pkexec), and the resources this account can reach, with their address one click from the clipboard.

barWidget.description: VPN icon that is bright while connected, dim while off and in the bar's urgent colour while a sign-in is pending or the client reports an error; a click opens the panel.
